title: Vijnana Aranya, Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Avasiya Vidyalaya, Nazarbad
location: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Avasiya Vidyalaya, Nazarbad, Mysuru
teaser: Vijnana Aranya at Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Avasiya Vidyalaya, Nazarbad, Mysuru: session on learning mathematics and science through origami.
homepageMatter: On 26 July 2025, tAcT conducted a Vijnana Aranya at Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Avasiya Vidyalaya, Nazarbad, Mysuru. H. V. Muralidhara led a session on learning mathematics and science through origami.
